verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for a hosted AI app-building SaaS, so the axis applies. The evidence only says published apps and their Payload backend deploy to Figma's hosted infrastructure, with no documented way to choose a storage region. Manually connecting a Supabase project is a third-party arrangement, not Figma Make's own residency control, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
